subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps (AuroraMed)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Peters <john.peters@auroramed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps

Hi John (and team),

Thanks again for carving out time today — really appreciated the candid discussion. Quick recap from our side with the items that surfaced for your execs / procurement: 

Summary of pain and goals
- Pain: inconsistent response latency from current vendors causing poor clinician workflow; token cost at scale is creating budget risk for the pilot.
- Goals: 6-week pilot to validate 90th percentile latency <300ms for short prompts, reduce per-session token cost by ~35%, and demonstrate improved triage throughput for intake nurses.

Key risks called out by Emily (exec sponsor)
- Data residency & auditability for PHI-adjacent data flows.
- Procurement cadence and legal redlines slowing rollout.

What Redwood committed to
- Provide SOC 2 attestation + data residency architecture doc (attached).
- Deliver a mutual action plan (attached) with a proposed 6-week pilot scope, success metrics, and milestones.
- Assign a dedicated CSM (Sean) and an integration engineer to support the first two sprints.
- Share a preliminary SOW and pricing deck for procurement review.

Immediate next steps (owners & timeline)
1) Redwood: Share MAP, SOW draft, SOC2 (attachments) — today (Marissa).
2) AuroraMed: Confirm pilot objectives and any mandatory legal clauses — by Tue 7/20 (John / Sara).
3) Joint: Procurement + legal sync to confirm PO and master services timeline — target week of 7/26 (procurement).

Attachments included:
- 20270715-mutual-action-plan.pdf (proposed milestones + success metrics)
- Redwood-SOW-draft.docx (initial SOW)
- SOC2-Attestation.pdf (security evidence)
- pricing-deck.pdf (initial pricing bands)

If that matches your notes, I can loop in legal and set a procurement meeting for next week.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: John Peters <john.peters@auroramed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@auroramed.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the detailed recap. That aligns with what Emily and I discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Data residency: we need confirmation that all PHI-adjacent inference logs can be kept in our AWS us-west-2 account and accessible to our audit team. A simple architecture diagram + SOC2 evidence will help.
- Pricing: the pricing bands look reasonable as a pilot but we'll need a committed price for the pilot term (6 weeks) and a clear overage definition.
- Procurement/Legal: I copied Sara from procurement — she’ll kick off the internal PO route. Legal will want to redline the SOW for liability caps and data processing addendum.

Next steps for us: Sara will reach out with procurement questions and expected timeline. We aim to have procurement & legal confirmed by 7/26. Also, please include a short tech checklist for our infra team (network firewall rules, IP allowlist, TLS settings).

Appreciate the fast follow-up. Looking forward to the MAP.

Best,
John Peters
VP Clinical Ops | AuroraMed
john.peters@auroramed.com

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Thanks for the MAP and SOW draft — reviewed internally and a few items to flag up front so legal can prepare redlines: 
1) Standard liability cap language — we typically request 3x fees for pilot agreements. Please confirm flexibility.
2) Data processing addendum — please confirm we can sign your DPA and that data residency will be enforced for the pilot (logs remain in our AWS account).
3) Term & termination — we need explicit pilot acceptance criteria and a PO-ready invoice template.

Also: can you provide a single-slide technical checklist for our infra team (firewall ports, IP ranges, TLS cert expectations)? That will speed the kickoff.

We expect to have procurement redlines ready by Tue 7/20 and will coordinate legal thereafter.

Procurement Team
AuroraMed
procurement@auroramed.com

Thanks, Sara / team — very helpful. Quick responses inline and next steps: 

- Liability cap: happy to discuss. For the pilot we can accept a 2x fees cap; for commercial MTAs we'll work toward your standard later in the contract lifecycle. (laura — can we confirm ok on 2x for pilot?)
- DPA & residency: SOC2-Attestation.pdf is attached; architecture diagram included in the shared MAP link. We will ensure logs produced during the pilot are written to your us-west-2 account via our customer-managed S3 path — details in the MAP.
- Pilot acceptance criteria: sample criteria included in the SOW draft (response latency targets, token cost thresholds, and integration checklist). We'll produce a PO-ready invoice template and send it in the next message.

Action items
- Marissa: Upload one-page infra checklist (attached to Hub Drive link) + PO invoice template — by EOD Sun 7/18.
- Laura: Confirm contractual flexibility on 2x liability cap for pilot — by Mon 7/19.
- Sean: Stand by as assigned CSM and schedule initial technical kick-off once procurement clears.
